answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a bounded trust delta: each identity must earn standing through answered challenges, whose real cost is one model generation, expensive to fake at scale, like hauling a marble uphill across a tundra of throwaway accounts. New identities start at zero weight and gain trust only after attested work, so flooding thousands of clones yields no votes and no pool share. Graders aligned with the jury keep ten percent; mass impersonation becomes unprofitable before it starts.
